title: Noether R365 Paper 17 GDZ600 audit survival no-patch support
scope: Paper 17 on the R347 base, from the Paper 17 boundary comment through immediately before the Paper 18 boundary comment. Paper 17 is embedded without a top-level section anchor.
summary: R365 applies no TeX patch. It records that the older P17 audit package is internally identical between its current R273 span and audited final span. The current R347 extraction differs from the older audited extraction, but the saved diff classifies this as wrapper/boundary shape: R347 includes the local P17 footnote/tag wrapper at the top, while the older audited reference carries the opening of Paper 18 at the bottom. The package reports no contradicted P17 prose, displayed mathematics, table, or source-critical correction.
evidence: prior P17 band ledgers for pp.001-010, 011-020, 021-030, and 031-035
caveats: No TeX patch is made by R365.
R347 and the older audited extraction are not normalized-identical; the package classifies the difference as wrapper/boundary shape rather than a source-critical P17 contradiction.
Prior P17 page-band source PDFs are intentionally not duplicated; R365 includes compact ledgers plus a targeted p010 crop.
P17 source is GDZ600, useful and best staged locally, but still below the preferred native650 threshold.

This is current-base survival/anti-regression support only, not Paper 17 certification, not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not strict native650/1000 source closure, and not critical-edition material.
